subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt or review https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this Control UI resolver fix, or request a fresh same-repository PR?
rationale: The source-level issue remains valid, but an open cross-repository PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks a duplicate automated repair lane.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile the moved UI path, and handle the fork branch limitations.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Ask for a current-main UI-only resolver PR with focused proof if the cross-repository branch is too stale or inconvenient to adopt.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, reconcile the moved UI path, and handle the fork branch limitations.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the channel UI metadata path and the current moved Control UI files.
